For each exact number \(k\) of distinct values used:

- Choose the \(k\) values: \(\binom{9}{k}\).
- Since each chosen value must appear at least once, count positive compositions of \(10\) into \(k\) parts: \(\binom{10-1}{k-1}=\binom{9}{k-1}\).

Thus the total is

\[
\sum_{k=1}^{3} \binom{9}{k}\binom{9}{k-1}
= \binom{9}{1}\binom{9}{0}
+\binom{9}{2}\binom{9}{1}
+\binom{9}{3}\binom{9}{2}.
\]

\[
= 9\cdot 1 + 36\cdot 9 + 84\cdot 36
= 9+324+3024
= 3357.
\]

\[
\boxed{3357}
\]
